text:
Alana: Heads-up — planning the awards + swag station for the summer retreat next Thursday. quick check on volunteers and inventory?
Jess: I can run the station but need a co-runner for the 1–3pm shift.
Mike: I’ll cover 1:30–3:30 if that helps, happy to overlap for handoff.
Olivia: Where are we storing the physical spot-award vouchers? need printing details.
Alana: We have 120 vouchers in the office supply closet (box labeled RETREAT-23). Rebecca is handling printing for the last-minute ones.
Rebecca: Confirmed — I have a PDF template. can print on 110gsm and cut to 4.25x2.75in.
Sam: Shipping update: two swag crates arrive Monday AM. contains shirts, stickers, enamel pins. tracking 1Z999AAA.
Jess: Perfect. can we get a small inventory sheet at the station? want to avoid running out of pins mid-day.
Alana: Yes — Rebecca, can you put together a simple checklist? stock, voucher count, receipt log. something we can reuse.
Rebecca: will do. checklist draft: 
```
- start: count shirts by size (S/M/L/XL)
- pins: count (qty)
- stickers: qty
- vouchers: total printed/remaining
- float cash: $200 for ad-hoc spot recognitions
- volunteer sign-in sheet
```
Olivia: For the float cash, do we have a petty cash form? finance needs reconciliation.
Alana: Good call — finance wants receipts and the signed petty cash form. I'll DM finance the template.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: event supplies need to be logged in the internal inventory system by EOD Tuesday.
Mike: About awards — what’s the approval process for spot-award amounts? some managers want $200 instead of $100.
Alana: Standard: managers can recommend up to $250 but need manager+director sign-off. we'll have approval stickers at the station for any >$150.
Jess: Can we do pre-printed approval stickers? less friction.
Rebecca: I can make 50 approval stickers (yes/no + manager name).
Sam: Also: accessibility — can we include low-sensory options at the station? quieter corner / checkbox for no surprise recognition.
Alana: Love that. we'll set a table flag "Quiet/Private" and offer sealed envelopes for awards.
Mike: Logistics question — do we need a card scanner or tablet to log awards live? wifi there is flaky.
Alana: Bring an offline Google Forms copy + a volunteer clipboard. we can import entries later.
Jess: Volunteer schedule suggestion: 
- 9:30–11 — Jess + Rebecca
- 11–1 — Alana + Sam
- 1–3 — Mike + Olivia
- 3–4:30 — float/reconciliation (Alana + anyone available)
Sam: I'm bringing a label maker and small cash box.
Olivia: I'll bring stamps and envelopes for sealed awards.
Mike: Anything needed from comms for signage?
Alana: Yes — can someone from comms make 2 signs: "Recognition Station" and "Quiet/Private". size A2. Jess can ping comms.
Jess: pinging @comms in a separate message.
Alana: Action items: 
1) Rebecca: print vouchers + checklist + 50 approval stickers — due Mon EOD
2) Sam: confirm crate arrival and bring labeler + cash box — Mon AM
3) Jess: signage + run station morning shift
4) Mike & Olivia: afternoon shift + sealed envelopes
5) Alana: petty cash form to finance + import template for offline logging
peopleops-bot: People Ops checklist created: /docs/events/retreat-2026/recognition-station-checklist.pdf
Jess: If nobody objects, I'll post a sign-up in #all-hands for extra volunteers.
Rebecca: small note — we should laminate the voucher stack to prevent water damage.
Sam: I'll bring a small laminator sheet set.
Alana: Thanks team — this is looking good. last call for questions before I lock the volunteer roster at 3pm tomorrow.
Olivia: all good from me. excited! :tada: 
Mike: thumbs up
Jess: thanks all — will follow up with comms and post the sign-up.
Alana: locking this thread now — will update if anything changes.
